name: Dubai Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority
instrument: Virtual Assets and Related Activities Regulations 2023 and accompanying Rulebooks
description: Dubai VA licensing regime covering VASP categories (Broker-Dealer, Custody, Exchange, Lending, VA Issuance, Advisory, and others), market conduct, consumer protection, and custody rulebooks.

locator.title: Virtual Assets and Related Activities Regulations 2023

modules.obligation: A person must not carry out a VA Activity in Dubai unless licensed by VARA for that specific activity category (for example Custody Services, Broker-Dealer, Exchange, VA Issuance). The licence application must map each product to a VA Activity and demonstrate fitness, propriety, and a viable compliance programme.
evidence_checklist: VARA licence (or application) listing each VA Activity
fit-and-proper documentation for controllers and senior managers
compliance-programme description submitted with the application

modules.obligation: Licensed Custody VASPs must safekeep client virtual assets separately from firm assets, maintain accurate books of client entitlements, and implement wallet and key-management controls (including cold storage for a material portion of holdings) consistent with the Custody Services Rulebook.
evidence_checklist: client-asset segregation policy aligned to the Custody Rulebook
wallet inventory distinguishing firm vs client, hot vs cold
daily reconciliation of on-chain balances to the client ledger

modules.obligation: VASPs must maintain a Dubai-appropriate governance structure with a competent board or equivalent, appointed senior officers (including compliance and MLRO functions), documented policies, and clear reporting lines into the licensed entity.
evidence_checklist: governance policies approved by the board

modules.obligation: VASPs must identify, manage, and disclose conflicts of interest arising from proprietary activity, related-party dealings, dual roles (for example issuer plus custodian of the same token), and staff personal holdings.
evidence_checklist: conflicts-of-interest policy covering issuer-custodian dual role

modules.obligation: VASPs must not engage in, and must have controls to detect, market manipulation, wash trading, spoofing, and misuse of inside information. Entities that operate markets or distribute tokens need surveillance, insider lists, and escalation to VARA where required.

VASPs must treat clients fairly, provide clear product information, operate an accessible complaints scheme with defined timelines, and keep records of complaints, outcomes, and remediation. Vulnerable-client considerations should be built into onboarding and support.
evidence_checklist: client-support channels in English and Arabic as appropriate

modules.obligation: Client-facing materials must describe the virtual asset, the VASP's role, material risks (including custody, peg/reserve, and technology risks), fees, and the regulatory status of the product. Disclosures must be kept current and not omit facts that would make them misleading.
evidence_checklist: product disclosure statement / white paper for each token
risk-warning set covering custody and reserve risks

modules.obligation: VA Issuance activity requires a VARA-compliant white paper, ongoing disclosure of material changes, and, for asset-referenced or commodity-linked tokens, a description of backing, custody of backing assets, and redemption mechanics.
evidence_checklist: VA Issuance white paper submitted or prepared for VARA
description of gold/commodity backing and custodians

modules.obligation: Where a issued virtual asset is represented as backed by commodities or other assets, the issuer must hold matching reserves with an appropriate custodian, prohibit encumbrance that would defeat holder claims, and obtain periodic independent attestation of quantity, quality, and segregation of the backing assets.

VASPs must implement a risk-based AML/CFT programme including CDD/KYC, ongoing monitoring, Travel Rule transmission of originator/beneficiary information, sanctions screening, and SAR/STR reporting via the MLRO.
evidence_checklist: AML/CFT policy and business risk assessment
CDD/KYC playbooks and Travel Rule tooling

modules.obligation: VASPs must maintain technology, cyber-security, and operational-resilience controls proportionate to custody and issuance activities, including access management, incident response, penetration testing, and business continuity for wallet infrastructure.
evidence_checklist: incident-response plan with VARA notification triggers

modules.obligation: Licensed VASPs must maintain paid-up capital, liquid resources, and professional-indemnity or equivalent insurance at the levels specified for their licensed VA Activities, and report capital adequacy to VARA on the required cycle.
evidence_checklist: paid-up capital evidence vs. activity category minima
